title: crataegus oxyacantha var. melanocarpa
intro: Crataegus oxyacantha var. melanocarpa, commonly known as Black Haw, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving menopausal symptoms, and supporting cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Black Haw are attributed to its ability to relax smooth muscle, reduce spasms, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
